CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.access_from_locate : ∀ (key : ℕ)
  (blocks : List CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block) (f : CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Focus),
  CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.locate key blocks = some f →
    ∀ (scratch : Bool),
      let out :=
        CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.run
          (CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.capacity f.before + 2 * f.before.length + 4)
          (CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.initial f.before.length blocks scratch);
      out.dataTape = (CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.focusState f).tape ∧
        out.controlTape = CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.unary f.before.length ∧
          out.scratch = scratch ∧ out.phase = CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.Phase.halt
CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.access_storage : ∀ (pre : List CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block)
  (selected : CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block) (post : List CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block)
  (scratch : Bool) (k : ℕ),
  CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.cells
      (CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.run k
        (CurrentMain.PositionalMetadataAccess.initial pre.length (pre ++ selected :: post) scratch)) =
    CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.capacity (pre ++ selected :: post) + (pre.length + 2)

CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.machine_result : ∀ (second : Bool)
  (pre : List CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block) (selected : CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block)
  (post : List CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block) (scratch : Bool) (r : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.run second (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.totalTime pre selected)
        (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.initial pre.length (pre ++ selected :: post) scratch r) =
      CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.final second pre selected post scratch ∧
    CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.Halted
        (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.final second pre selected post scratch) ∧
      ∀ k < CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.totalTime pre selected,
        ¬CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.Halted
            (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.run second k
              (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.initial pre.length (pre ++ selected :: post) scratch r))
CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.acquisition_from_locate : ∀ (second : Bool) (key : ℕ)
  (blocks : List CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block) (f : CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Focus),
  CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.locate key blocks = some f →
    ∀ (scratch : Bool) (r : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
      CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.run second

          ∀ k < CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.totalTime f.before f.selected,
            ¬CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.Halted
                (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.run second k
                  (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.initial f.before.length blocks scratch r))

CurrentMain.PaidPairedAcquisitionResources.entrance_resources : ∀ (second : Bool)
  (pre : List CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block) (selected : CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block)
  (post : List CurrentMain.PackedMetadataSlots.Block) (scratch : Bool) (r : SequentialBitAddition.Registers),
  let s := CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.initial pre.length (pre ++ selected :: post) scratch r;
  CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.totalTime pre selected ≤ 7 * CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.cells s ∧
    CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.run second (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.totalTime pre selected)
          s =
        CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.final second pre selected post scratch ∧
      CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.Halted
          (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.final second pre selected post scratch) ∧
        (∀ k < CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.totalTime pre selected,
            ¬CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.Halted (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.run second k s)) ∧
          ∀ (k : ℕ),
            CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.cells (CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.run second k s) ≤
              2 * CurrentMain.PaidPairedTrackAcquisition.cells s

limits: The initial complete marked packed store, supplied marked unary position, separate empty output tape and fixed track selector remain explicit.

The 7V time and 2V tape-cell bounds apply to this actual three-tape run and its original represented entrance volume. Finite control/register fields are separate; no selected global recursion or full multiplication cost is inferred.
Physical encoding, store construction, initial allocation, arithmetic operation implementation and output writeback remain separate caller obligations.
